items.description: TheTool is the first Performance-Based ASO (App Store Optimization) tool that allows app or game developers, brands, startups and companies track and optimize theirs apps' visibility on Apple App Store & Google Play Store.

Weglore is a location based photo sharing app that allows users to explore the globe with map navigation and photo markers. The photo series incorporates smart social functions that enable filtering of unwanted photos and sharing photos pertaining to a similar subject. The Weglore mobile app users geolocation to add metadata to photos, and enables users to subscribe to photos aggregated to a particular location, with optional notification settings as well as other functions. The app is free and can be downloaded for Android from Google Play.

The Google Play Developer API allows developers the opportunity to automate tasks concerning subscriptions, in-app purchasing, and general app-management. One may gain access to the API by signing into their Google Developer Console.

Murfie is a digital music marketplace that goes beyond digital. Murfie actually stores users disks and gives them access to the digital content whenever they need it. The company also uses users disks to expand their digital marketplace.
A free resource for viewing, sharing, mixing and mashing maps online. Created by the UCL Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, you can select any number of maps to overlay and view.
An online language-learning site providing tutoring and coaching for Arabic, French, and Spanish.

ManiadeCelular.com.br is a community for cell phone and electronics consumers. Ask and answer questions, read tips, reviews and ratings from other members or from the Mobile Mania staff. See releases from all major device manufacturers and carriers.
Polaris is a cross platform desktop Google Analytics widget built using the Adobe AIR environment. With 8 standard reports it lets you keep your data always instantly available.

Smartsheet is a SaaS company that offers a businesses collaboration and work management tool. The Smartsheet and DocuSign integration will enable users to electronically sign documents such as contracts.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.
Takes addresses submitted with a Formstack form and displays the locations on a Google Maps map.

Gadget that includes 4 tabs that display Amazon.com favorite features: Amazon Gold Box and Lightning deals, Amazon Bestsellers, Amazon Movers and Shakers, and Amazon Search. Users can select Amazon's product category of their choice.
